phase: Phase 2: The print-audit block and the overview table (by Wed 2026-11-18)
summary: Round 2: the fixes in be41213 are verified and the Phase 2 contract still holds end to end. The guide.ts tie-break now follows D13 (worst score, worst blocker recall, median, route name), both scripts take the newest score file by modification time, update.sh refuses a symlinked data path and exits 0 on a no-change rerun, and guide.ts refuses inherited flag names; the CLI and data contracts are unchanged except these fixes. The rebuilt preview agrees with model-guide.json cell-for-cell, the six real rows are identical to round 1, and the wording still matches spec D17 to D19 with the Q1, Q2, and 2.4a rulings. Round-1 items: P2C1-1 and P2C1-2 are resolved by the new P2ADV-6 test, P2C1-4 and P2C1-5 are fixed and pinned, P2C1-3 is known as the open PM question, and P2C1-6 carries over as P2C2-1. Two nonblocking items: the plan marker note (carry-over) and the unpinned blocker_recall field name that the D13 recall tie-break reads. Task 2.8 remains the open check task of the phase and is not counted as a finding.
nonblocking_findings: P2C2-1 [Nit] review-c: Carry-over of P2C1-6, still open. The plan.md file-map note (line 93-97) still says the overview block goes between <!-- model-guide:start --> and <!-- model-guide:end --> after </nav>, while the shipped mechanism inserts the section at the '<header class="hero' anchor and dedupes by id="model-guide" (preview.sh insert_overview); no marker comments exist anywhere. The placement contract itself holds and is now pinned (adversarial-p2.test.ts:428 above-hero assertion, :440 one-section dedupe). Rationale: the plan note diverges from the implementation and could mislead the Phase 5 publish work; the owner of plan.md should update the note.

P2C2-2 [Nit] review-c: The D13 first tie-breaker (higher worst blocker recall) reads the field name pass.blocker_recall in guide.ts (readTrackARank), but no fixture or test carries that field: grep finds blocker_recall in no test file and not in fixtures/guide/review-scores-mini.json, and P2ADV-1 exercises only the median branch (test comment: 'With no recall field the median decides'). review-score.ts (Phase 4 task 3.3) does not exist yet; if it writes another field name, the recall tie-break silently degrades to 0 for every route. Rationale: a one-sided integration contract in my wiring scope; pin blocker_recall in the Phase 4 score-file Red tests or in a guide tie-break test with recall values.
